Hi, I’m Zhixin Zhu

I’m a Computer Science undergraduate focusing on HPC and AI. Currently a member of the SCC Team at Sun Yat-Sen University, experienced with C++, Python, CUDA, and MPI.

Education

  • B.S. in Computer Science and Technology, Sun Yat-sen University (Aug 2023 – June 2027 Expected)
    • GPA: 3.8 / 4.0
    • Coursework: Artificial Intelligence; Machine Learning; Optimization Theory; Data Structures and Algorithms; Mathematical Analysis I & II

Research & Projects

  • Yat-CC (Feb 2025 – July 2025)
    • Refined the Intelligent TA knowledge base by optimizing data structures for enhanced retrieval quality.
    • Curated a compiler theory instruction-tuning dataset sourced from lecture slides and course materials.
    • Applied PEFT (LoRA) to Qwen3-Instruct-8B via PyTorch, boosting code comprehension and error feedback logic.
  • Optimization of code_saturne — ISC Student Cluster Competition (Mar 2025 – May 2025)
    • Addressed communication bottlenecks via MPI implementation comparisons and disk I/O minimization strategies.
    • Achieved a significant 2.7× performance improvement for the LES_AIR_QUALITY case on Bridges 2.
    • Fixed GPU runtime errors; scalability requires architectural redesign.
  • Estimate Relative Camera Pose (Sep 2025 – Feb 2026)
    • Designed a minimal solver for relative pose estimation using point correspondences and surface normals.
    • Evaluated robustness and efficiency with several benchmarks.
  • vLLM-Ascend Sampler (Nov 2025 – Jan 2026)
    • Identified performance bottlenecks in Top-K / Top-P sampling during LLM inference on Ascend NPUs.
    • Implemented Triton-based fused sampling kernels to reduce kernel launches and memory access overhead.
    • Achieved up to 1.88% latency reduction compared to the native Ascend 910 implementation.
  • Optimization of HPL-MxP (Nov 2025 – Feb 2026)
    • Evaluating performance and reliability of Huawei SDMA for large-scale dense linear algebra.
    • Integrating SDMA support into the HPL-MxP execution framework.
    • Optimizing single-block low-precision LU factorization without panel reordering.
